parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, primarily made of glass with a rectangular shape covering the front area.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from the connected device, such as images, videos, and text.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in position and does not move independently; it is supported by the base and stand.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum, providing stability and support for the screen.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the entire display structure, ensuring it stands upright and stable on a surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move; it may allow limited tilt adjustment through the connecting stand.
